attrs.remaining_trust: That the declared references are complete. The intersection is computed over origin_refs, assumption_refs and common_cause_refs AS WRITTEN, so this is a universal about the registry rather than about the world. Note the error direction, which is why the claim is worth having at this strength: an UNDECLARED shared reference can only make the overlap larger, never smaller, so under-declaration cannot make this claim false. What it can do is make the claim uninformative — if ASM-SUBSTRATE-INTEGRITY is present on every instrument because that is the house style rather than because it was checked, the floor is a convention that happens to be true.
attrs.rule: complete enumeration of a finite domain that is DEFINED by the registry under test
